journal.action: Agent 1720 main planning team issued wave 1: 14 groups under 5 managers covering Tracks 1–7, the Lean foundation, a new discharging track, and a survey of other deductive routes. Nothing is checked off before the critic gate.

node.title: Safe path of length d+1, all triangulations n≤10
node.statement: For every triangulation G with n≤10, every v with deg v∈{4,5}, every proper 5-colouring with c(v)=5: a K1-safe path of length ≤ d+1 to a ≤4-colouring of G−v exists, d the BFS distance.
node.killCriteria: One instance with no K1-safe path of length ≤ d+1.

notes.text: Issued by the Agent 1720 main planning team, wave 1. Not accepted until the critic gate.

node.title: Monotone Kempe reduction
node.statement: From every proper 5-colouring of a planar triangulation there is a Kempe sequence along which the size of colour class 5 never increases and reaches 0.
node.approach: Agent 1720 group K5, manager M-Kempe. Tested on n≤10.
node.killCriteria: One colouring where no monotone sequence exists.

notes.text: Issued by the Agent 1720 main planning team, wave 1. Not accepted until the critic gate.

node.title: Four-colour Kempe classes at a degree-5 vertex
node.statement: For every triangulation G and degree-5 vertex v, every Kempe class of 4-colourings of G−v that uses 4 colours on N(v) contains a colouring using ≤3 colours on N(v). This is Kempe's induction with unrestricted swap sequences.
node.approach: Agent 1720 group K6, manager M-Kempe. Compute n≤11; literature Heawood, Errera, Kittell, Tilley.
node.killCriteria: One written triangulation, vertex, and Kempe class with no fixable colouring.

notes.text: Issued by the Agent 1720 main planning team, wave 1. Not accepted until the critic gate.

node.title: P(G,k)>0 for d-degenerate G, k≥d+1
node.statement: Written proofs for degenerate, outerplanar, series-parallel, and planar k≥6 positivity, plus the strongest k=4 restricted-family statement provable here.
node.killCriteria: A written proof has a gap the critic can point to.

notes.text: Issued by the Agent 1720 main planning team, wave 1. Not accepted until the critic gate.

node.title: Tait colourings = nowhere-zero 4-flows = P(T,4)/4
node.statement: Check on the dual of every triangulation n≤10 and write the planar duality proof.
node.killCriteria: A count mismatch on some T.

notes.text: Issued by the Agent 1720 main planning team, wave 1. Not accepted until the critic gate.

node.title: Algebraic edge-colouring (Alon–Tarsi)
node.statement: Test whether a sign-invariant graph-polynomial identity gives a deductive non-vanishing proof for planar cubic 3-edge-colouring.
node.killCriteria: Sign cancellation shows no invariant exists on small graphs.

notes.text: Issued by the Agent 1720 main planning team, wave 1. Not accepted until the critic gate.

node.title: Track 8: Discharging and reducibility
node.statement: Audit and extend the discharging and reducibility code (Plan 1). Minimum: a verified D-reducibility check of the Birkhoff diamond.
node.killCriteria: Existing code misstates what it computes and cannot be repaired within the wave.

notes.text: Issued by the Agent 1720 main planning team, wave 1. Not accepted until the critic gate.

node.title: Survey: deductive routes not in the roadmap
node.statement: Tait-Hamiltonian, Hadwiger, vector cross product, Birkhoff–Lewis equations, Eliahou, Matiyasevich, perfect-matching forms, RSST, Gonthier. Recommend at most three new tracks.
node.killCriteria: Critic finds no recommended route is more than a restatement.
